run_filter_tsv_keep_matching: run filter_tsv.py to keep only stdin lines whose filenames exist in the given TSV file
run_filter_tsv_exclude_matching: run filter_tsv.py to exclude stdin lines whose filenames exist in the given TSV file
run_filter_tsv_no_skip_header: run filter_tsv.py with --no-skip to treat the TSV file as having no header row
review_get_fname: review the get_fname function that extracts a filename without extension from a TSV line
refactor_filter_tsv_logic: refactor filter_tsv.py to support additional filtering criteria beyond filename matching
